pick.name: Astro (static) on Cloudflare Workers, cross-posted to dev.to with canonical URLs
pick.what: Markdown/MDX content site (blog, portfolio, /now, /changelog) deployed free on Cloudflare
pick.why: Typed, popular, Claude-Code-friendly, MIT; Cloudflare acquired the Astro team (2026-01-16) and kept it MIT and multi-host; matches the default hosting pick
pick.free_limits: Astro free; Cloudflare Workers Free static assets (see Ship + operate)

alts.name: Ghost
alts.what: Publishing platform with built-in newsletter and memberships
alts.why: Best if site + newsletter + paid memberships should be one product; Ghost(Pro) Starter $18/mo annual (1,000 members) or self-host

alts.name: Hugo
alts.why: Best if you want zero Node dependencies; Go templates are less pleasant for Claude Code than Astro components

candidates.name: Ghost
candidates.verdict: All-in-one with newsletter; paid or self-host

candidates.name: Hashnode
candidates.verdict: June 2026: custom domains, API, GitHub backup moved to Pro ($5/seat/mo); free = hashnode.dev subdomain only

candidates.name: dev.to
candidates.verdict: Use as a cross-post channel, not the home

candidates.name: Next.js
candidates.verdict: Overkill for a content site; Astro ships less JS

decision: Astro on Cloudflare gives an owned domain, free hosting and a stack Claude Code writes well; the Cloudflare acquisition adds funding without a licence change. Cross-post to dev.to with canonical URLs for reach. Pick Ghost instead only if you want site + newsletter + paid memberships in one tool.
details: Hashnode free tier cut (June 2026) is a 2026 free-tier reduction to flag.

verify.note: Astro post (2026-01-16): the Astro Technology Company team joined Cloudflare; Astro stays MIT and platform-agnostic. Hashnode official pricing confirms custom domain, GraphQL API and GitHub backup are Pro ($5/seat/mo); free = hashnode.dev only.
